Last-position partition gives C_i(p)=C_(i-1)(p)+[w_i=last(p)] C_max(0,i-3)(prefix(p)), including the empty-pattern convention. An independently written iterative exact-integer deck enumerator traversed EVERY binary word for n=7..17: all 2^n observations are distinct for 7<=n<=16; at n=17, 131072 words yield 131056 vectors, exactly 16 doubletons and no larger fiber. A second literal-index implementation independently matched all n=7..10, and direct checks of all 16 collision pairs and reversal/complement orbit actions corroborated the four size-four orbits (source file COLLISIONS.csv). This is a rigorously bounded finite census; nothing is claimed for n>=18 or vacuous n<7.
